title: fail-closed admission predicate for the OI metrics manifest (research only, DRAFT, no loader code)
ruling_source: Codex 6489944476 (GO: OI-LOADER-01 admission contract, DRAFT docs/tests only)

ruling_6489828197.N1_N2: authoritative true means the bulk request used explicit frozen bounds; it does not mean the dataset is complete or usable. covers() alone is never a loader admission gate. The loader fails closed unless authoritative, complete, stopped null, failures empty, covers() and a verified file entry for every required day all hold.

ruling_6489428240.J1: explicit --start and --end are mandatory for authoritative output; dry-run/screening output is mode screening, authoritative false
ruling_6489428240.J3: completeness is relative to the required interval [required_start, required_end_exclusive); covers() is the final coverage gate; an end_exclusive equal to the sealed cutoff is allowed, a range past it is refused

review_6490219007.source: Cowork result on #238 @ 937f14e: predicate PASS; hardening H1, H2 applied
review_6490219007.H1: malformed value types refuse, never raise: non-finite numbers refused before the digest; every file-entry and coverage value type- and ISO-checked before use; any residual exception is SCHEMA_MALFORMED
review_6490219007.H2: per-file bytes capped at max_bytes_per_file; groups is binding and must equal the coverage-derived grouping (open question Q7)

ruling_6490314342.Q1: sub-windows allowed: a request may lie inside the manifest window but never outside [manifest.start, manifest.end + 1 day)
ruling_6490314342.Q2: digest and total_bytes recompute stay global fail-closed integrity preconditions, separate from P6; identity validation covers every manifest file entry
ruling_6490314342.Q3: mandatory loader step: before any row is read, every file admitted for the request must match its exact byte size and SHA-256 on disk; a missing file or mismatch refuses
ruling_6490314342.Q4: per-symbol evidence, all-or-nothing batch admission: one refused symbol refuses the whole requested set, every symbol's reasons still reported; a single-symbol request is independently admissible
ruling_6490314342.Q5: exact coverage envelope: for every symbol coverage.required_start == manifest.start and coverage.required_end_exclusive == manifest.end + 1 day; a mismatch refuses even when covers() passes
ruling_6490314342.Q6: minimal refusal schema: failures is a list, stopped is null or an object; non-empty failures / non-null stopped refuse via P4 / P3 before any file read; nested content is audit payload only (diagnostic, never a crash, never an admission)

ruling_6490439004.H1: every malformed value returns a deterministic SCHEMA_* refusal and never raises; types validated before any hashing, membership test or date arithmetic; booleans rejected wherever integers are required; exact zero-padded ISO dates; NaN/Infinity rejected at schema entry; the catch-all is SCHEMA_MALFORMED and maps only unexpected malformed input, never a programmer error on a valid manifest
ruling_6490439004.H2_bytes: each file entry bytes is an int (bool excluded) in [1, 104857600] (100 MiB); larger refuses, no clamping (Q8 resolved)
ruling_6490439004.H2_groups: groups is binding (Q7 resolved): keys exactly strict_complete / conditional_with_holes / short_history; each value a sorted duplicate-free list of symbols; the three lists exactly partition manifest symbols; every symbol sits in the list matching coverage[symbol].group
ruling_6490439004.Q6_scope: the minimal audit rule applies ONLY to nested failures / stopped content, after their top-level types are checked and P3/P4 refuse; it relaxes no file, coverage, groups, date, numeric or digest check

code_identity.pre_merge_note: the contract was drafted against #225 head f850323; the cited files are byte-identical at merged master f8f03df (git diff f850323 f8f03df is empty for them)

pinned_files._rule: sha256 of the git blob bytes of each path at master_reference (git show <master_reference>:<path>), content-addressed so a moving master cannot invalidate the pin

rebind.note: #225 merged as master f8f03df; every citation is rebound from f850323 to f8f03df and the cited files are pinned by sha256. The contract stays DRAFT and unsigned until Integration signs; a semantic change to a pinned file reopens it.

slice.reference_evaluator: tests/test_oi_loader01_contract.py holds a pure reference evaluator over a dict manifest. It imports no repo module and no fetcher, reads no file but this JSON, and does no I/O. It is a test oracle, not a loader.

scope.consumer: the future OI metrics loader (later ticket), research only
scope.input: one manifest dict as written by oi_metrics_fetch.build_manifest, one requested symbol, and a requested interval [required_start, required_end_exclusive) as ISO date strings
scope.output: admit or refuse with refusal codes; refusal is the default
scope.authority: none: no PAPER, no runtime, no order or sizing authority

pinned_values.available_rule: UNSET: raw zips only, no rows read; the metrics loader ticket must fix the PIT rule

manifest_schema.pinned_values_citation: oi_metrics_fetch.py module constants FORMAT, LOADER_VERSION, SOURCE_CLASS, DATA_ROOT, AVAILABLE_RULE, CUTOFF (= oi_metrics_probe.CUTOFF) and oi_metrics_probe.GATE_MONTHS @ f8f03df
manifest_schema.file_entry_note: the size field is named `bytes`; `status` (fetched/resumed) is dropped by build_manifest and is not a manifest field
manifest_schema.gap_citation: oi_metrics_fetch.py:_gap and :boundary_gaps @ f8f03df; a gap is null or exactly these fields
manifest_schema.stopped_fields_note: audit payload only (Q6): a stopped object whose fields differ adds DIAG:audit_content and is refused by P3; it is never a precondition
manifest_schema.digest_rule: digest == sha256 hex of canonical(manifest without `digest`), canonical = json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) encoded ascii
manifest_schema.total_bytes_rule: total_bytes == sum of every file entry `bytes`
manifest_schema.max_bytes_per_file_note: 100 MiB per daily metrics zip (ruling 6490439004); bytes outside [1, 104857600] refuses, no clamping
manifest_schema.groups_rule: binding: groups == {g: sorted(s for s in symbols if coverage[s].group == g) for g in groups}, exactly as oi_metrics_fetch.py:groups @ f8f03df writes it (a dict of three sorted lists of str); ruling 6490439004: keys exactly the three groups, each value a sorted duplicate-free list of symbols, the lists exactly partition symbols, every symbol in the list matching coverage[symbol].group
manifest_schema.coverage_envelope_rule: for every symbol: coverage.required_start == manifest.start and coverage.required_end_exclusive == manifest.end + 1 day (ruling 6490314342 Q5); covers() cannot excuse a mismatch

value_rules.non_finite: no float NaN, Infinity or -Infinity anywhere in the manifest, audit payload included; rejected at schema entry, before the digest
value_rules.integers: every integer field (bytes, total_bytes, gate_months, gap days, month-run months) is type int; a bool is refused
value_rules.file_entry: path, symbol, date, sha256 and source are str; bytes is int (never bool), min_bytes_per_file <= bytes <= max_bytes_per_file
value_rules.coverage_listed_first_last: null or a strict ISO date (iso_date_rule)
value_rules.coverage_missing_days: missing_days and missing_required_days are lists of strict ISO dates
value_rules.coverage_required_bounds: required_start and required_end_exclusive are strict ISO dates
value_rules.coverage_gap: null or {start: null or strict ISO date, end_exclusive: strict ISO date, days: null or int >= 0}
value_rules.coverage_month_run: {months: int >= 0, start: null or YYYY-MM, end: null or YYYY-MM}
value_rules.never_raise: evaluation never raises: a value check runs before every use, and any residual exception is a SCHEMA_MALFORMED refusal

date_semantics.request_interval: [required_start, required_end_exclusive): required_start is included, required_end_exclusive is excluded; the required days are required_start .. required_end_exclusive - 1 day
date_semantics.end_exclusive_vs_cutoff: required_end_exclusive == cutoff (2026-09-28) is ALLOWED (last day 2026-09-27); required_end_exclusive > cutoff is REFUSED
date_semantics.end_exclusive_citation: oi_metrics_fetch.py:covers @ f8f03df (raises when required_end_exclusive > CUTOFF; equality allowed; test_covers_cutoff_equality_allowed_past_refused)
date_semantics.manifest_end_is_inclusive: the manifest `end` is the last fetched date (inclusive, < cutoff, oi_metrics_probe.py:check_end); the manifest window is [start, end + 1 day)
date_semantics.manifest_end_citation: oi_metrics_fetch.py:run and :plan @ f8f03df (plan coverage uses min(end + 1 day, CUTOFF) as required_end_exclusive)
date_semantics.iso_date_rule: every date (request bounds, manifest start/end, file entry date) is a str matching ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ that parses as a real calendar date; no time part, no timezone, no week or ordinal form, no basic form
ambiguous_boundary_refused: request interval not inside the manifest window [start, end + 1 day)
manifest start null (a screening/default-bounds output; J1)

identity_rules.symbol_rule: the entry symbol matches symbol_regex and is listed in manifest `symbols`; the requested symbol must be in `symbols` and in `coverage`
identity_rules.path_rule: path == path_template filled with the entry's own symbol and date (both must agree with the path)
identity_rules.source_rule: source == source_template filled with the entry path (string identity only; the loader never fetches it)
identity_rules.date_rule: entry date obeys iso_date_rule, lies inside the manifest window [start, end] and is before the cutoff
identity_rules.bytes_rule: type is int (never bool, float or str) and 1 <= value <= 104857600 (manifest_schema.min/max_bytes_per_file); no clamping
identity_rules.uniqueness: no two file entries share a path; per required day exactly one entry for (requested symbol, day)
identity_rules.scope_of_identity_check: every file entry in the manifest is checked, not only the requested symbol's: one bad entry anywhere refuses the whole manifest

preconditions_fail_closed.rule: the manifest, a file entry, a coverage entry, groups, a month run or a non-null gap is not a JSON object
a NaN or +/-Infinity float anywhere in the manifest; rejected at schema entry, before the digest
any field not listed in manifest_schema at the top level, in a file entry, a coverage entry, a gap or a month run (not stopped: audit payload, Q6)
any listed field absent at any of those levels
any pinned_values field differs (unknown format, loader_version, source_class, data_root, series, mode, cutoff_exclusive, gate_months or available_rule)

authoritative or complete not a bool; files, failures or symbols not a list; stopped neither null nor an object; total_bytes not an int; any file-entry or coverage value violating manifest_schema.value_rules
manifest start or end violates iso_date_rule (start null included), end >= cutoff, or start > end
symbols not a sorted duplicate-free list of symbol_regex strings, coverage keys != symbols, or groups keys != the three groups

groups not a dict of exactly the three groups, a value not a sorted duplicate-free list of str, the lists not an exact partition of symbols, or a symbol not in the list matching coverage[symbol].group
a coverage entry's required_start / required_end_exclusive differs from manifest start / end + 1 day (manifest_schema.coverage_envelope_rule)
the requested symbol list is not a non-empty list of distinct str, or a requested symbol is not in manifest symbols
request interval not inside the manifest window [start, end + 1 day)
total_bytes != sum of file entry bytes
digest does not match digest_rule, or cannot be recomputed
an unexpected exception while VALIDATING the input (malformed input the explicit checks did not name); after validation, an exception is a programmer error and propagates, never a silent refusal

admission_predicate.rule: admit only when every precondition passes AND all six conjuncts are true together; any failure refuses

conjuncts.citation: oi_metrics_fetch.py:build_manifest (mode bulk, authoritative True) and :plan (screening, False) @ f8f03df
oi_metrics_fetch.py:build_manifest (complete = not failures and stopped is None) @ f8f03df
oi_metrics_fetch.py:covers @ f8f03df (listed_first <= required_start, listed_last >= required_end_exclusive - 1 day, no missing_days inside the interval; incomplete record -> False)

conjuncts.expr: every required day in [required_start, required_end_exclusive) has exactly one verified manifest file entry whose path/date/symbol/hash/size identity is valid and belongs to the requested symbol and window

admission_predicate.p6_note: P6 checks the manifest record only; the mandatory disk_verification step follows it before any row is read (ruling 6490314342 Q3).
admission_predicate.n1_n2_shape: authoritative true, complete false, one failure, stopped null, covers() still true (the listing reaches every day) and the failed day has no file entry: refused by P2, P4 and P6

disk_verification.rule: after the manifest stage admits a symbol and before any row is read, every file entry of that symbol dated inside [required_start, required_end_exclusive) is read from disk; its byte length must equal `bytes` and its sha256 must equal `sha256`; the manifest record alone is insufficient

refusals.DISK:unreadable: any other read error or a non-bytes result

disk_verification.reference_model: the reference evaluator takes an injected read_bytes(path) callable; it is called only for symbols whose manifest stage passed, never when P3 or P4 already refuse

batch_admission.rule: every requested symbol is evaluated and reported separately; the request is admitted only when every requested symbol is admitted (all-or-nothing); one refusal refuses the whole set, so the universe never shrinks silently
batch_admission.single_symbol: a single-symbol request is independently admissible
batch_admission.report: {symbol: reasons} for every requested symbol, including admitted ones (empty reasons)

audit_payload.rule: only the container types are preconditions (failures a list, stopped null or an object); a non-empty failures or non-null stopped refuses via P4 / P3; nested content is never a precondition
audit_payload.diagnostic: DIAG:audit_content when nested content is malformed (a non-object failure item, or stopped fields other than reason/status/url); a diagnostic never admits and never raises
audit_payload.scope: ruling 6490439004: applies only to nested failures / stopped content after the containers are type-checked and P3/P4 refuse; it relaxes no file, coverage, groups, date, numeric (NaN/Infinity included) or digest check
audit_payload.precondition_interplay: when a precondition refuses and the audit containers are well-typed, P3 / P4 are still reported beside the precondition code

evaluation_order: per requested symbol: request bound checks, then the non-finite scan, then schema/version/type/value/date/symbol/groups/coverage-envelope/window/total_bytes/digest preconditions (first failure refuses, no conjunct evaluated, P3/P4 still reported), then all six conjuncts evaluated and every failing one reported, then disk_verification only when all six hold; any residual exception is SCHEMA_MALFORMED; finally batch_admission (all-or-nothing)
forbidden: reading a zip or CSV row
synthesizing, forward-filling or interpolating a missing day
importing oi_metrics_fetch or any repo module from the contract test
deferred: loader implementation (later ticket, after this contract is signed)
point-in-time availability rule (manifest available_rule is UNSET)
bulk download (blocked on EDGE04 resource ownership and an Integration release)
OI features, ML training, PAPER/runtime wiring

negative: each of P1..P6 failing alone with the other five true
wrong symbol, wrong date and wrong path identity
hash absent or malformed (length, uppercase, non-hex)
size absent, zero, negative or non-int
coverage claims strict_complete while a file entry is absent
unknown field, unknown version, ambiguous date boundary
H1: NaN/Infinity, path as list or dict, coverage listed_first/listed_last/missing_days non-str or non-strict ISO, every file-entry value mistyped
H2: bytes outside [1, 104857600] (10**400 included), groups missing / extra key, unsorted, duplicate, symbol missing from or in two lists, group/coverage mismatch
6490439004: bools where ints are required, non-zero-padded dates, SCHEMA_MALFORMED on unexpected malformed input, an injected internal bug on a valid manifest propagates
Q3: disk file missing, size mismatch, hash mismatch
Q4: multi-symbol request with one symbol refused refuses the set, every symbol reported
Q5: coverage envelope start / end mismatch refused while covers() passes
Q6: malformed nested failures / stopped content refused via P4 / P3 with a diagnostic, never raised

resolved_questions.resolution: sub-windows allowed inside [manifest.start, manifest.end + 1 day); REQ_WINDOW refuses anything outside
digest and total_bytes stay global fail-closed preconditions separate from P6; identity covers every file entry
disk_verification is a mandatory loader step before any row is read
container types only; nested failures / stopped content is audit payload (audit_payload), scoped by 6490439004
groups is binding: exact three keys, sorted duplicate-free lists, exact partition of symbols, consistent with coverage groups (SCHEMA_GROUPS)
bytes is an int in [1, 104857600] (100 MiB), bool excluded, no clamping
